lines.zh: 我用弹跳代步，一下一下。
lines.en: I travel by hops, one after another.

lines.zh: 落地时，我背上的杆子晃了晃。
lines.en: On landing, the rod on my back sways.

lines.zh: 我一跳就能跨过整条沟。
lines.en: One hop clears a whole ditch.

lines.zh: 草被我压弯，我又弹起来。
lines.en: The grass bends and I spring up again.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，再弹起。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and bounce up.

lines.zh: 我的影子一跳一跳地跟着我。
lines.en: My shadow follows with a hop, hop.
I head where the storm clouds gather.
Each landing throws a ring of dust.

lines.zh: 我不擅长直走，更喜欢蹦。
lines.en: I'm no good at straight lines; bouncing suits me.

lines.zh: 背上的杆子拖在地上，响。
lines.en: The rod drags on the ground, ringing.

lines.zh: 我从石块上弹了一下，越过去。
lines.en: I bounce off a rock and clear it.

lines.zh: 跳得高些，就能看清远处。
lines.en: From higher hops I can see farther.

lines.zh: 我落地很重，脚踝却没事。
lines.en: My landings are heavy, but my ankles hold.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂一路蹦过去。
lines.en: I bounce along the field ridges.

lines.zh: 每跳一次，杆子就往下沉一点。
lines.en: Each hop sinks the rod a little deeper.
Mid-hop, I can hear the wind.
I crouch with the rod planted beside me.
I'm listening for thunder.
My breathing is slow and heavy.
The grass here will do.
Done hopping, I rest a while.

lines.zh: 他们说我死了会留下灰。
lines.en: They say my death leaves ash.
I look up. The clouds are thick.
When the storm comes, I must hide.

lines.zh: 我的杆子有点歪，我掰正。
lines.en: The rod is crooked; I straighten it.

lines.zh: 这片地我守着，不让人踩。
lines.en: I keep this ground; no one tramples it.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔草叶上的露水。
lines.en: I lick the dew from a blade of grass.
The wind rises; I flatten down.
I chew slowly, for a long time.
I sort of want to hop again.

lines.zh: 半空里我容易被打下来。
lines.en: In midair I'm easy to knock down.
I'm not fierce unless you block me.
You're standing in my way.
I know that crossbow in your hand.
Can you hit me in midair?

lines.zh: 我背上的东西，不是装饰。
lines.en: What's on my back isn't decoration.
Watching me leap, or watching me land?
I won't move first unless you do.
You carry no smell of thunder.
I'm this heavy; you can't push me.
This grass is mine. Stand further off.
Step back and I'll let you pass.
I tilt my head up; the rod tips with it.
I've measured the distance for this leap.
I sway and the rod goes crooked.
Pain pushes me a step back.
I sprawl, then bounce half upright.
You hit my back with a dull sound.
My hide is thick. You know that.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，没什么表情。
lines.en: I blink once, expressionless.
A few dark spots spatter the grass.
I grunt, low and dull.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得我耳朵发鸣。
lines.en: That blow leaves my ears ringing.
I'm not angry; I just want to leave.
Grass? I do eat that.
You hold out grass; I shift nearer.
No hurry. Let me sniff first.
This is good. I chew it slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里那把，比我脚边的嫩。
lines.en: What's in your hand is tenderer than what's by my feet.
Set it down. I'll come myself.
I don't watch people while I eat.
Another handful and I'll stay.
Don't let your hand shake; it startles me.
I'm still chewing the last mouthful.
This grass is sweet. Not bad.
Two hops bring me to the grass.
You hold it high, out of my reach.

lines.zh: 我不吃存粮，只吃新鲜的。
lines.en: I only eat it fresh.
As I shift closer, the rod rattles.
Be patient; I eat slowly.

lines.zh: 你撞我，像撞上一段树桩。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a stump.
I didn't budge; your hand must be numb.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，把你也震了一下。
lines.en: My landing shakes you too.
Don't stand where I land.
My bulk nudges you half a step aside.
The rod hits you with a dull thud.
I shift aside slowly so I won't crush you.
One bump and I bounce off.

lines.zh: 你的脚陷进我压出的坑。
lines.en: Your foot sinks into the pit I made.

lines.zh: 我们各退一步，谁也别撞。
lines.en: We both step back. No more bumping.
Another one crouches in the grass too.
Our rods touch once.
When it crouches, its rod sits lower than mine.
We chew grass together, very quietly.
Our kind don't need words.
It hops; I hop.

lines.zh: 雷云来了，我们各自找地方。
lines.en: The storm comes; we each find cover.
It shields me from a gust.
We crouch back to back.
When it clears, we part.
I take that tuft of grass in my mouth.
I lower my head; the rod tilts with me.
Can this be eaten?
I sniff it and tuck it beside my cheek.

lines.zh: 掉落物里，我只挑能吃的。
lines.en: From the drops I take only what's edible.
The pearl is hard; I can't chew it.
I pin it with a foot and look down.
It rolled; I hop after it.
I press it into the grass to hide it.
Done, I go back to chewing grass.
You stepped on my grass.
I lift my head and raise the rod.
This leap lands on you.
Back away and my shadow still finds you.
I leap first, then bring it down.
Blocking the rod won't save you.

lines.zh: 我盯住你了，很慢但很准。
lines.en: I've fixed on you: slow, but precise.
You're wearing iron. It carries current.
I bunch my hind legs, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 这是我最后一次让路了。
lines.en: That was my last warning.
You run; I hop once to close in.

lines.zh: 我的影子跳起来又落下。
lines.en: My shadow leaps and falls.

lines.zh: 你躲在树后，树挡不住雷。
lines.en: Behind a tree? Trees don't stop lightning.
I'm calculating your direction.

lines.zh: 你抬弩了，我知道你要射。
lines.en: You raise the crossbow. I know you'll fire.

lines.zh: 我在半空最容易被你打下来。
lines.en: Midair is where you can knock me down.

lines.zh: 你的脚步踩在湿草上，有声。
lines.en: Your steps hiss on wet grass.
I wait for you to stop.
Run once more and I leap.

lines.zh: 你换方向，我的落点也换。
lines.en: You change direction; my landing point changes.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，把杆子砸下去。
lines.en: I leap and drive the rod down.
A crack opens in the ground, smoking.
You can block this, but it's heavy.

lines.zh: 我落在你旁边，土都飞了。
lines.en: I land beside you and dirt flies.
The shield jolt numbs your hands.
The rod on my back carries a current.
The shock drops you to your knees.
I hop again, closer this time.
A ring of grass is scorched.
This strike is slow. Don't rush.
I raise my head out of the grass.
One roll of thunder and I'm awake.

lines.zh: 杆子先立起来，我再站起。
lines.en: The rod rises first, then me.
I land and the grass lies in a ring.
Good grass here. I'll stay.
I lift my head slowly to the sky.
Someone's come to this meadow.

lines.zh: 我背上的杆子生了点锈。
lines.en: The rod on my back has some rust.
This ground is mine from now on.
One hop carries me out of the pit.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的背，毛都卷了。
lines.en: Fire scorches my back; the fur curls.

lines.zh: 落地的冲击从脚底传上来。
lines.en: The landing jolt comes up through my feet.

lines.zh: 水没到我的鼻子，我拼命蹬。
lines.en: Water reaches my nose; I kick hard.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的杆子吹歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocks my rod askew.
A crossbow bolt buries in my leg.

lines.zh: 光扫过来，我背上的杆子响了。
lines.en: Light sweeps past and the rod rings.
The grass here has been gnawed bare.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我直接倒下去。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I go straight down.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，杆子先不见了。
lines.en: I fall, and the rod vanishes first.
